title: wpr-education district data file
description: Shape of data/districts/{dpi_code}.json and data/state.json. Cells with value null must have suppressed true and vice versa — jsonschema can't express the iff cleanly, so pipeline/validate.py enforces it in code.

generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the refresh run that produced this file

topics.description: Keyed by topic id (act, forward, preact, ap, graduation, dropouts, absenteeism, enrollment, open_enrollment, finance). Each topic maps school years to metric objects. Metric names per topic are defined during normalization and documented in CLAUDE.md's Data model section.

schools.description: School roster, config districts only: school code -> {name, type, last_year}. A lightweight nav index so the district page never fetches the full data/schools file; the full per-school metrics stay in data/schools/{dpi_code}.json.
